title: when the timetable download fails and the cached copy is more than a day old, delays, status and watch lose ticket numbers

evidence.command: renfe delays / renfe status 03081 / renfe watch 03081
evidence.when: the GTFS timetable on disk is 30 hours old and the refresh from ssl.renfe.com fails (503)
evidence.seen: delays reports every scheduled time as unavailable, and status/watch can no longer find a train by the number on the ticket
evidence.known: the cached feed covers several weeks ahead, so the copy on disk would have answered
